messages:
maria.g: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: hotfixes live but we need closure on action items. Sharing a compact checklist and looking for owners/ETAs.
aj: Paste checklist pls.
maria.g: 1) SDK backoff bump, 2) resume handshake on server, 3) prefix-cache TTL audit/logs, 4) scheduled regression runs for partial responses, 5) dashboard + weekly digest for recurrence patterns.
cheng: I'll own (3). EOW ETA.
sophia: I'll own (4). Plan: reuse eval harness with jittered network and chunked streams. Target next Wed.
aj: I'll ship (1) today -> PR + release tomorrow.
oncall-jordan: ops-bot shows eu-west-1 tail at ~03:00 UTC last week. I'll add a heatmap and autoscale correlation panel.
ops-bot: Alert: streaming-timeout-rate spike 4.2% at 2026-03-15T03:12Z (threshold 1%).
maria.g: For (2) proposal: keep KV cache 3s post-disconnect, accept resume token for that window. Draft spec linked internally.
cheng: Hypothesis: truncated client close frames leaving stale prefixes. I'll add session_close_reason logs and metric stream_prefix_kv_ttl_miss.
sophia: Regression job: scheduled CI that runs harness, random chunk sizes + jitter. Auto-file issue if partial-response rate > 0.5% over 1h.
aj: SDK defaults: exponential backoff 200ms->8s with jitter. I'll update CHANGELOG and announce.
maria.g: Owners recap: SDK=aj, Resume=eng-runtime (sophia), Cache=cheng, Regression=sophia, Monitoring=oncall-jordan.
oncall-jordan: I'll create dashboard cards and weekly digest, and enable slow-trace capture for reconnects >2s.
maria.g: Timeline: SDK by tomorrow, cache logs by EOW, regression job by next Wed, resume spec review in 3 days, dashboards by Friday.
cheng: Filing INFR-4127 for prefix-cache TTL audit.
sophia: Filing STREAM-781 for regression job.
oncall-jordan: Filing DASH-129 for heatmap + digest.
maria.g: 15-min sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to unblock any blockers. React :thumbsup: to confirm.
aj: :thumbsup:
cheng: :thumbsup:
sophia: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Calendar created: "Streaming aftercare sync" 2026-03-24T16:30Z.
